quests.instruction: Which small letter is the partner of Z?
quests.hint: Say the name of Z: 'zee'. The small letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: Z and z are two forms of the same letter, named 'zee'.
quests.funFact: Z says 'zzz', like a buzzing bee or someone sleeping.

quests.instruction: Which lowercase letter matches E?
quests.hint: Small e is the first letter of earth. Capital E is the first letter of Earth.
quests.explanation: Capital E, small e. Compare Earth and earth.
quests.funFact: Capital E has one long line and three arms pointing right.

quests.instruction: Match the small p with its capital letter.
quests.hint: Say the name of p: 'pee'. The capital letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: P is the partner of p. It looks like a tall line with one bump at the top.
quests.funFact: Capital P is a tall line with one bump at the top.

quests.instruction: Which capital letter is the same letter as o?
quests.hint: Think of Onion. What capital letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: Capital O, small o. Compare Onion and onion.
quests.funFact: The letters 'oo' can say 'oo' as in moon, or a shorter sound as in book.

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that goes with S.
quests.hint: The small partner looks like a small curvy snake.
quests.explanation: S and s are two forms of the same letter, named 'ess'.
quests.funFact: Capital S and lowercase s have the same snake shape, just different sizes.

quests.instruction: Which pair shows V and its own small partner?
quests.hint: One pair has two letters named 'vee'. Which one?
quests.explanation: vV is a match: V and v are the same letter, 'vee'. The other pairs mix two different letters.
quests.funFact: W looks like two V's, and its name even says 'double-u'.

quests.instruction: Which pair joins D to the same letter in small form?
quests.hint: Check each pair: are both letters the same letter, one big and one small?
quests.explanation: Both D and d are called 'dee', so Dd is the partner pair.
quests.funFact: 'Duh' and 'tuh' are made in the same place in your mouth, but for D your voice hums.

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that goes with q.
quests.hint: The capital partner looks like a circle with a little tail.
quests.explanation: Q is the partner of q. It looks like a circle with a little tail.
quests.funFact: Capital Q looks like O with a little tail.

quests.instruction: Capital C has a small partner. Which one is it?
quests.hint: The small partner looks like a small open curve.
quests.explanation: C and c are two forms of the same letter, named 'cee'.
quests.funFact: Lowercase c is just a smaller version of capital C.

quests.instruction: Match the capital L with its small letter.
quests.hint: Say the name of L: 'ell'. The small letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: Capital L, small l. Compare Leaf and leaf.
quests.funFact: L is letter number 12 of the 26 letters, with 11 letters before it and 14 after it.

quests.instruction: The word Yoga begins with a capital Y. Which small letter is the partner of Y?
quests.hint: Think of how Yoga is written in small letters.
quests.explanation: In yoga, the same letter is written small: y.
quests.funFact: Lowercase y has a tail that hangs below the line.

quests.instruction: Which pair has M next to its small letter?
quests.hint: Say the name of each letter in the pair. Do both names match?
quests.explanation: Mm is right. The other pairs do not have the same letter in both places.
quests.funFact: In many languages, the word for mother begins with M, like mama and mum.

quests.instruction: Small k has a big partner. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Think of Kitten. What capital letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: K is the partner of k. It looks like a tall line with two arms that reach out on the right.
quests.funFact: Kite, key and kangaroo all begin with K.

quests.instruction: Find the pair where B meets its partner.
quests.hint: Check each pair: are both letters the same letter, one big and one small?
quests.explanation: Both B and b are called 'bee', so Bb is the partner pair.
quests.funFact: Capital B has a straight back and two round bumps.

quests.instruction: Match the capital D with its small letter.
quests.hint: The small partner looks like a round tummy on the left with a tall stick on the right.
quests.explanation: d is the partner of D. It looks like a round tummy on the left with a tall stick on the right.
quests.funFact: Dolphin, dinosaur and dragon all begin with D.

quests.instruction: Look at Ice cream. Its first letter is a capital I. Which lowercase letter is the same letter?
quests.hint: The small partner of I looks like a short line with a dot on top.
quests.explanation: Ice cream has a capital I; ice cream has a small i. Same letter, two forms.
quests.funFact: I is letter number 9 of the 26 letters, with 8 letters before it and 17 after it.

quests.instruction: Which uppercase letter matches g?
quests.hint: Say the name of g: 'gee'. The capital letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: G and g are two forms of the same letter, named 'gee'.
quests.funFact: G is letter number 7 of the 26 letters, with 6 letters before it and 19 after it.

quests.instruction: Find the pair that mixes up W with a different letter.
quests.hint: Say each letter's name. One pair has two different names.
quests.explanation: Wu is the odd one: W goes with w, not with u.
quests.funFact: Water, window and wolf all begin with W.

quests.instruction: Capital X has a small partner. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Small x is the first letter of x-ray. Capital X is the first letter of X-ray.
quests.explanation: x is the partner of X. It looks like two short lines crossing.
quests.funFact: At the end of a word, X says 'ks', as in fox, box and six.

quests.instruction: Which pair does NOT match? One of them mixes up V.
quests.hint: Look at the pairs one at a time. Which pair mixes up two different letters?
quests.explanation: Vy does not match: V and y are different letters. The other pairs show the same letter in two forms.
quests.funFact: V is letter number 22 of the 26 letters, with 21 letters before it and 4 after it.

quests.instruction: Which capital letter is the partner of s?
quests.hint: The capital partner looks like a curvy snake shape.
quests.explanation: Capital S, small s. Compare Spider and spider.
quests.funFact: The letters 'sh' say 'shh', like when you ask for quiet.

quests.instruction: Which pair matches R with the same letter?
quests.hint: Say the name of each letter in the pair. Do both names match?
quests.explanation: rR is a match: R and r are the same letter, 'ar'. The other pairs mix two different letters.
quests.funFact: The name 'ar' sounds like the first part of art.

quests.instruction: Which small letter is the partner of Y?
quests.hint: Say the name of Y: 'why'. The small letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: Y and y are two forms of the same letter, named 'why'.
quests.funFact: The name of Y, 'why', sounds just like the question word.

quests.instruction: Paint starts with a capital P. Which small letter matches it?
quests.hint: Say Paint and listen to the first sound. Which small letter makes the same sound?
quests.explanation: Paint has a capital P; paint has a small p. Same letter, two forms.
quests.funFact: Lowercase p hangs below the line, like a stick with a circle on top.

quests.instruction: Which capital letter is the same letter as h?
quests.hint: Say the name of h: 'aitch'. The capital letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: Capital H, small h. Compare Hook and hook.
quests.funFact: Capital H looks like two tall lines joined by a bridge.

quests.instruction: A sign says PARK. Which word says the same thing in small letters?
quests.hint: Match the letters one at a time, from left to right.
quests.explanation: PARK and park are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, bark and pack, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: The name 'pee' rhymes with tree and sea.

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that goes with M.
quests.hint: Small m is the first letter of mirror. Capital M is the first letter of Mirror.
quests.explanation: M and m are two forms of the same letter, named 'em'.
quests.funFact: Capital M and W are upside-down versions of each other.

quests.instruction: Two pairs are real partners. Which pair is wrong? Look at the pair with Q.
quests.hint: Say each letter's name. One pair has two different names.
quests.explanation: Qd does not match: Q and d are different letters. The other pairs show the same letter in two forms.
quests.funFact: Q is letter number 17 of the 26 letters, with 16 letters before it and 9 after it.

quests.instruction: Which capital letter is the partner of f?
quests.hint: Think of Flower. What capital letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: F is the partner of f. It looks like a tall line with two arms pointing right.
quests.funFact: Fish, frog and fox all begin with F.

quests.instruction: Look at the sign: MENU. Which word matches it in lowercase letters?
quests.hint: Each capital letter has a small partner. Find the word whose letters are all partners.
quests.explanation: MENU and menu are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, many and mend, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: M says 'mmm'. Close your lips and hum to make it.
